findings: actions/checkout pin comment wrong — comment says '# v7' but v7 does not exist (current stable is v4); SHA 3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 needs verification against the actual v4.x release SHA and the comment must be corrected.

Branch name collision on same-day re-runs — branch='chore/tool-versions-$(date +%Y-%m-%d)' produces the same name on multiple runs within one calendar day; a second git push fails because the remote branch already exists. Append github.run_number or similar to guarantee uniqueness.

git add -A stages all changes instead of the specific modified files — low harm on a fresh runner but violates the repository convention; stage rust-ci/Dockerfile, rust-desktop/Dockerfile, document-tools/Dockerfile, and ci/install-tools.sh explicitly.
Version strings with dots are unescaped in sed patterns for crane, proot, and jq — dots act as wildcards; escape them to avoid theoretically incorrect matches.
